descriptionChirho: A proper noun designating a city on the northern rim of the Arnon gorge in Moab, and possibly a second settlement in Gad's territory. All sixteen occurrences refer to this geographic location with only prepositional variation (from-Aroer, in-Aroer, bare Aroer). Multilingual evidence is consistent: Spanish 'Aroer,' Hindi 'अरोएर' (Aroer), Arabic 'عَرُوعِيرَ/عَرْعيرَ' (ʿArūʿīra/ʿArʿīra), Korean '아로엘' (Aroel), Swahili 'Aroeri' — all transliterations of the same toponym.
